content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER_WIN | Refex Industries Limited (NSE: REFEX) Refex Industries secures ash transportation rate contract worth Rs. 31.13 crore ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Contract Value: Rs. 31,13,05,500/- (incl. GST) - Scope: Slab-wise Rate Contract for Ash Transportation to construction site of road projects of NHAI and other Central/State road construction authorities - Execution Period: 1 year (extendable by 6 months) - Client: Entity based in Maharashtra (Domestic) 📌 What happened: ↳ Refex Industries Limited has received a slab-wise rate contract for ash transportation with a cumulative maximum award value of Rs. 31.13 crore, valid for one year and extendable by a further six months. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Declares 2nd Interim Dividend of Re. 1 per Share
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company declared 2nd interim dividend and updated capacity expansion timelines along with financial results approval.
content_feed.telegram_post: 💵 #DIVIDEND | Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited (NSE: BEPL) Bhansali Engineering Polymers Declares 2nd Interim Dividend of Re. 1 per Share ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Dividend: Re. 1/- per equity share (100%) - Face Value: Re. 1/- each - Record Date: Saturday, 24th October, 2026 - Payment Date: On or before 17th November, 2026 - Expansion Update: ABS production capacity expansion (75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA) delayed to March, 2027 due to global supply chain disruptions 📌 What happened: ↳ The Board of Directors approved the un-audited financial results and declared the 2nd interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. Additionally, the company reported a revision in the commissioning timeline for its Rs. 200 crore expansion project. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
